findings.text: the "Reproducing commands" run measure.py, measure_section.py and measure_final.py, which live only in the ephemeral run directory and not in the repository, so the sentence "From a checkout at this run's head" overstates reproducibility and the table's only drift guard is a script that will be deleted with the run.

p25 54.9 and p75 1315.1 come from statistics.quantiles(n=4)'s exclusive method, yet the paragraph at :83 invites a reader to compute them from the inlined rows, where linear-interpolation quartiles give 55.0 and 354.0 on p75, so the convention is unstated and a reader recomputing gets a materially different p75 without explanation.
